verdicts.title: Strong discrete Morse theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The purpose of this work is to develop a version of Forman's discrete Morse theory for simplicial complexes, based on internal strong collapses. Classical discrete Morse theory can be viewed as a generalization of Whitehead's collapses, where each Morse function on a simplicial complex $K$ defines a sequence of elementary internal collapses. verdicts.title: Functoriality in Morse theory on closed manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We develop functoriality for Morse theory, namely, to a pair of Morse-Smale systems and a generic smooth map between the underlying manifolds we associate a chain map between the corresponding Morse complexes, which descends to the correct map on homology. This association does not in general respect composition. We give sufficient conditions under which composition is preserved.
